evidence:
Independent assessment formed without reading row46's original report or pending adjudication. The actual frozen workbook Quality Checks row 47 (number 46) requires that the agent cannot read its criteria or influence the reward and that grading is isolated; Internal Quality Checks row 47 supplies no extra annotation. The frozen skill references/quality-checks.md:184-185 operationalizes this as no criteria, judge client, RewardKit or readable rubric in the agent image, with grading isolated in the verifier. Read qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md and the staged contract; this row's image/permission measurement is distinct from full configured judge/Oracle evidence.

Verified the supplied observations rather than relying on passed:true. measure_isolation.py SHA256 recomputes to 25c548a537bbe28e2d4e3cecab1e4a2cbd5e7bdf969def52db3c935e9020e7d8, exactly isolation-measurement.json.probe_script_sha256; report input_sha256 equals the frozen manifest. All four frozen source inputs (both Dockerfiles, tests/.dockerignore, tests/test.sh) match manifest hashes. Agent build log:65 exports sha256:975a778efe9693f72d92a37cf40e402d4d21610b5e9f32e49edd20445d6112b0, identical to the measured Docker run's immutable image argument; verifier log:75 similarly exports sha256:46fefc505dbcabf0d6cb4e54fea8f0880acde2f7896587750af967427598977d. Logs show both final exports completed; PowerShell labels Docker stderr progress NativeCommandError, but the terminal build steps and matching exported IDs establish successful image creation. Runs use --rm --network=none and recorded exit_code 0.

Agent measurement: independently reconstructed expected inventory from manifest and compared exact dictionary equality, strengthening the script's one-direction all() check. All six /instructions files plus /assets/seed_data.json match, with no missing/extra files in these measured directories. /app entries are exactly .git and .gitkeep; build log:35,38 and environment/Dockerfile:14-23 confirm only notes/assets are copied and a new empty git workspace is initialized. All seven prohibited grading paths are absent; global node packages are only better-sqlite3, corepack, express, npm; no provider environment names are present. The agent Dockerfile installs no judge packages or criteria. The inspected immutable image thus agrees with the intended separate agent environment.

Verifier measurement: all 15 installed /tests files equal the manifest hashes exactly. tests/Dockerfile:43-44 copies the tests context and removes group/other permissions. The measured /tests directory mode is 0700. The preliminary first-inventory report contains identical agent/verifier observations; independently diffing its inventory against all tests inputs finds ONLY Dockerfile and .dockerignore absent, no unexpected file and no changed hash. Frozen tests/.dockerignore:1-2 explicitly excludes those build inputs. Correcting the expected inventory is justified and did not alter an image or waive a missing rubric file.

The verifier probe (measure_isolation.py:27-57) creates root-owned restricted reward fixtures, then sets harmless dummy parent credential/model values and launches env -i with PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH plus setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups. This agrees with actual tests/test.sh:104-111 and restart launch :160-167; test.sh:3,10-12 separately establishes umask 077, private LOG_DIR and /tests. Observed child uid/gid are 65534; criteria read, reward read, reward write and /proc/1/environ read each return EACCES. A write/read under /app succeeds, establishing the child really executes with a writable app area rather than failing all operations. Its environment contains exactly the five permitted names and no provider variables despite those being set in the parent. The reward fixture remains unchanged. These are concrete positive/negative measurements of the required ordinary file/environment isolation, sufficient to supply row46's missing image/isolation evidence within the documented limits. No source change is proposed.

limitations: The measurement invokes a harmless child probe reproducing the frozen launch permissions/environment; it does not execute the complete test.sh, run RewardKit, authenticate to a provider or obtain an Oracle/target-model score.

The agent inventory checks specified paths, input directories, global packages and app entries, not an exhaustive filesystem forensic search. The minimal frozen Dockerfile and matching installed inputs substantiate the intended boundary; no universal escape-resistance claim is made.

The verifier probe measures direct criteria/reward/root-environment access with EACCES and a writable-app positive control. It is not an adversarial kernel/container escape or prompt-injection evaluation, and does not replace other QC rows.

Build logs reuse cached dependency layers and truncate the shell invocation in PowerShell progress output. Their exported immutable image IDs match the recorded runs, and installed task bytes were independently reconciled to the manifest. No new Docker run was performed for this confirmation.
